Petitioner is the accused in Crime No.369 of 2018 of Adhur Police Station, Kasaragod District, which has been registered alleging commission of offences under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code.

2. The allegation against the petitioner is that on the false promise of marriage, the petitioner committed rape on the defacto complainant and impregnated the defacto complainant/victim, who later gave birth to a girl child.

3. The petitioner was never apprehended in connection with Crime No.369 of 2018 as he was abroad and an Absconding Charge Sheet was filed in 2019 and look out notice was issued to apprehend the petitioner/accused.
On the petitioner being apprehended, a further investigation under Section 173(8) of the Cr.P.C. is progressing.
On account of the look out notice, the petitioner was arrested when he arrived at the Calicut International Airport, Karipur on 10.10.2023.
The petitioner has been in custody since that date.
4. Learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that the petitioner and the victim were only in a consensual relationship.

It is submitted that the victim has now executed an affidavit which is produced along with Crl.M.C.1869 of 2021, which has been filed before this Court to quash the further proceedings against the petitioner in Crime No.369 of 2018, (now pending as L.P.C.No.4 of 2021) on the file of the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kasaragod.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kasaragod
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: It is submitted that after his apprehension on 10.10.2023, the petitioner has been subjected to potency test etc., and further detention of the petitioner is not necessary for the purpose of completing the investigation which is being carried out under the provisions of Section 173(8) of the Cr.P.C.
It is submitted that the petitioner may, therefore, be granted bail subject to conditions.
5. The learned Public Prosecutor opposes the grant of bail.
It is pointed out that in respect of the crime registered against the petitioner in the year 2018, the petitioner has evaded the process of law and was absconding.

It is submitted that though the continued detention of the petitioner may not be necessary for the purpose of investigation, if the petitioner is granted bail, there is every chance for the petitioner absconding.
6. Having heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor, I am of the opinion that the petitioner can be grated bail subject to strict conditions.
The petitioner has been in custody from 10.10.2023.
His continued detention is clearly not necessary for the purpose of completing further investigation under Section 173(8) of the Cr.P.C.
The apprehension expressed by the learned Public Prosecutor that the petitioner may abscond can be taken care of by imposing suitable conditions.

Therefore, the petitioner shall be released on bail subject to the following conditions:
(i) The petitioner shall execute a bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-(Rupees One Lakh only) with two solvent sureties each for the like sum to the satisfaction of the jurisdictional Court;
Usman vs State Of Kerala on 17 November, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/196251939/
2
(ii) The petitioner shall report before the Investigating officer in Crime No.369 of 2018 of Adhur Police Station as and when called upon to do so.
( iii )
The petitioner shall not influence or intimidate the victim or any witness in Crime No.369 of 2018 of Adhur Police Station;
(iv) The petitioner shall not involve in any other crime while on bail.
(v) The petitioner shall not contact the victim in any manner.
(vi) The petitioner shall surrender his passport before the Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kasaragod.

entities.text: Judicial First Class Magistrate Court-I, Kasaragod
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: If the petitioner does not have a passport, he shall execute an affidavit to that effect and file the same before the said court within seven days of release on bail.

If any of the aforesaid conditions are violated, the Investigating officer in Crime No.369 of 2018 of Adhur Police Station may file an application before the jurisdictional Court for cancellation of bail.

Sd/-
